class_text: Heavier than a GT3, with less downforce: grip comes from the tyres, not the wings. Brake straight, be smooth on the throttle and carry your speed. Mistakes cost time at once.
track_steps: Plan a pass well ahead. If it is not clearly on, back off and wait.
Faster car: pass safely and patiently. Slower car: stay predictable, no sudden line changes.
Mistakes here bite later. Finishing matters more than the position.
text_source: Handbook 4.2 p.9 (GT4 class text, Nordschleife Conduct Note), shortened by Claude
